spaces.get.title: Get space
spaces.get.description: Get one Contentful space by ID via GET /spaces/{spaceId}.

environments.get.title: Get environment
environments.get.description: Get one Contentful environment via GET /spaces/{spaceId}/environments/{environmentId}.

entries.get.title: Get entry
entries.get.description: Get one Contentful entry via GET /spaces/{spaceId}/environments/{environmentId}/entries/{entryId}.

entries.create.title: Create entry
entries.create.description: Create a Contentful entry via POST /spaces/{spaceId}/environments/{environmentId}/entries. Sends X-Contentful-Content-Type.

contentTypeId.description: Content type ID sent as X-Contentful-Content-Type.

entries.update.title: Update entry
entries.update.description: Update a Contentful entry via PUT /spaces/{spaceId}/environments/{environmentId}/entries/{entryId}. Requires X-Contentful-Version.

contentTypeId.description: Content type ID sent as X-Contentful-Content-Type.

entries.publish.title: Publish entry
entries.publish.description: Publish a Contentful entry via PUT .../entries/{entryId}/published. Requires X-Contentful-Version.

entries.unpublish.title: Unpublish entry
entries.unpublish.description: Unpublish a Contentful entry via DELETE .../entries/{entryId}/published. Requires X-Contentful-Version.

entries.archive.title: Archive entry
entries.archive.description: Archive a Contentful entry via PUT .../entries/{entryId}/archived. Requires X-Contentful-Version.

assets.get.title: Get asset
assets.get.description: Get one Contentful asset via GET /spaces/{spaceId}/environments/{environmentId}/assets/{assetId}.

assets.create.title: Create asset
assets.create.description: Create a Contentful asset via POST /spaces/{spaceId}/environments/{environmentId}/assets. Process and publish separately.

fields.description: Localized asset fields including title and file.

assets.publish.title: Publish asset
assets.publish.description: Publish a Contentful asset via PUT .../assets/{assetId}/published. Requires X-Contentful-Version.

content_types.get.title: Get content type
content_types.get.description: Get one Contentful content type via GET .../content_types/{contentTypeId}.

webhooks.list.title: List webhook definitions
webhooks.list.description: List Contentful webhook definitions via GET /spaces/{spaceId}/webhook_definitions.

skip.description: Number of webhook definitions to skip.
